description: TodoApp - Simple full-stack todo list with React + Express, in-memory state, full CRUD

userStories.title: Initialize monorepo structure
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a monorepo with server/ and client/ workspaces so subsequent stories have a place to live.
acceptanceCriteria: app/package.json declares workspaces for server/ and client/
app/server/ and app/client/ directories exist with their own package.json
app/server/tsconfig.json and app/client/tsconfig.json configured for TypeScript
app/client/vite.config.ts configures Vite with dev server on port 5173 and proxies /api/* to http://localhost:3000
Typecheck passes (tsc --noEmit across both workspaces)

userStories.title: Express server entry point with health endpoint
userStories.description: As a client, I need a running Express server exposing GET /api/health so I can confirm the backend is up.
acceptanceCriteria: app/server/ has an Express + TypeScript entry point listening on port 3000
GET /api/health returns 200 with JSON { ok: true }
Server start script runs from app/server/ (e.g. npm run dev)
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Vite + React client app skeleton
userStories.description: As a user, I want a React app that loads so I have a UI surface to build on.
acceptanceCriteria: app/client/ has a Vite + React + TypeScript app with a root App component
Dev server runs on port 5173
API requests to /api/* proxy to the Express server on port 3000
App renders a placeholder heading when loaded
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: In-memory todo store and REST API
userStories.description: As a client, I need full CRUD endpoints for todos backed by an in-memory store.
acceptanceCriteria: Todo shape: { id: string, title: string, completed: boolean }
GET /api/todos returns 200 with Todo[]
POST /api/todos with { title } returns 201 with created Todo; title is trimmed; empty/missing title returns 400
PATCH /api/todos/:id with { completed } returns 200 with updated Todo; unknown id returns 404
DELETE /api/todos/:id returns 204; unknown id returns 404
Server generates unique ids per process; state held in memory only
Typecheck passes

userStories.title: Todo list UI wired to API
userStories.description: As a user, I want to view, add, toggle, and delete todos from the web UI.
acceptanceCriteria: On mount, client fetches GET /api/todos and renders the list
Input + Add button posts a new todo via POST /api/todos; empty submissions blocked client-side
Each row has a checkbox that toggles completed via PATCH /api/todos/:id
Each row has a delete button that calls DELETE /api/todos/:id
UI re-renders from server responses (no optimistic updates required)
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill

userStories.title: API integration tests
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want integration tests covering the API so regressions get caught by the verifier.
acceptanceCriteria: Integration tests cover CRUD happy paths: list, create, toggle, delete
Tests cover 400 validation case when POST body has empty/missing title
Tests cover 404 cases for PATCH and DELETE on unknown ids
npm test from the root runs the tests and passes
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
